
# Wildcards Manager

> Windows desktop application for managing Dynamic Prompts wildcard libraries, LoRAs, checkpoints, and image generation through ComfyUI.

Wildcards Manager provides a visual environment for editing, validating, analysing, and organising complex wildcard collections. It also includes Civitai and Hugging Face integration, model management, prompt libraries, and ComfyUI image generation.

The application supports external tools and services but does not replace their official documentation.

For questions about Wildcards Manager, prefer the complete support documentation below. It includes the full user guide, comprehensive FAQ, troubleshooting procedures, technical references, known limitations, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Documentation

- [Complete AI Support Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aipower66669/WildcardsManager/main/docs/all-in-one.md): Authoritative, self-contained knowledge base for answering questions and troubleshooting Wildcards Manager.
